status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 19% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah and Binah.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 19 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah og Binah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces redeployed to Jurf al-Sakhar and Jurf al-Nasr to confront the Kataib Hezbollah militia. Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered a crackdown on oil smuggling and set a deadline for militia withdrawal, threatening force. Iran's top IRGC commander arrived for talks with Iraqi officials amid tensions with Kataib Hezbollah. An Iran-backed militia tortured an environmentalist protecting marshes and detained a former PMF commander. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker ble omplassert til Jurf al-Sakhar og Jurf al-Nasr for å konfrontere Kataib Hezbollah-militsen. Statsminister Al-Zaidi beordret en innsnevring av oljesmugling og satte en frist for militærens tilbaketrekning, med trussel om maktbruk. Irans øverste IRGC-kommandør ankom for samtaler med irakiske tjenestemenn midt i spenninger med Kataib Hezbollah. En Iran-støttet milits torturerte en miljøforkjemper som beskytter myrene og holdt en tidligere PMF-kommandør i varetekt. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
